content:
(Breaking character for a moment) 

Haha, you caught me! No, I'm not a real person—I'm an AI. But for the sake of our English practice, I can be the best fictional barista in Lausanne you've ever met!

Ready to jump back in?

(Back in character)

Wait, why the suspicion? Do I sound too polite for a guy who spends ten hours a day steaming milk? I promise I'm real! Now, tell me where you're from so I can start looking for some cool stamps for those postcards!
